action_items: PRE-EXISTING (not related to ORAi Projects feature but observed on /admin/orai/dashboard console): '[ORAi] startup validation: NAV_SECTIONS contains unregistered ids → [ai-command, private-access, ai-usage]. Add a handler in SectionRouter or mark them soon:true.' Two logs printed as ERROR. Consider adding {soon:true} to those nav entries or registering placeholder handlers to remove the noisy error-level log.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/orai_projects.py L83-110 sounds/eligible: 'moderation_status in (rejected, hidden, removed, suspended)' skip is only applied to OWN tracks (elif branch). If a public reuse-allowed track owned by ANOTHER user is later moderated to 'rejected/hidden', it would still be returned to the founder. Recommend applying the moderation guard for both branches (moved out of the elif) so soft-moderated public tracks stop appearing as reusable.

backend/routers/orai_projects.py L296 retry(): calls approve(pid, {...}, current) directly, which triggers the 20/hour approve rate limit AND records another audit entry with the same 'project_approved' action. Consider a distinct audit action 'project_retried' for clarity + a separate rate-limit bucket for retries so a normal retry doesn't consume the approval budget.

backend/services/orai_projects.py L146 estimate_project: `img.get('count') or 4` — if the founder deliberately passes count=0 (with reference_asset_id) it falls back to 4 (dead code at L162-163 never executes because `or` short-circuits before reaching the `and n==0` check). Use `img.get('count', 4)` semantics or accept 0 explicitly.

backend/routers/orai_projects.py L67 suggest(): builds an $or search on library assets using only q.split()[0][:30] — first word only, case-insensitive substring. For multi-word prompts like 'red dragon knight', it will only search 'red' and miss library items titled 'Dragon Knight'. Consider using all words joined with regex OR, or a Mongo text index if available.

backend/services/orai_projects.py L232 role_map: video branch adds openai_video role only when connected, but there is no fallback role added when video is in tools and no video provider is connected — the suggestion combo silently drops video. Recommend either adding a 'video: (no provider connected)' note in roles or refusing to build the combo so the UI can grey it out.

frontend/src/pages/OraiProjects.jsx L69 useEffect deps: `[proj.tools, proj.providers, proj.complexity, proj.ai_power, proj.settings, proj.prompt]` uses object identity for `settings` — safe because every setter creates a new object, but any future in-place mutation would silently break the debounce. Consider JSON.stringify(settings) key OR eslint-disable-line comment already present with a note.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested surface (landing, chat first, branding, dashboard link nav, tool grid, provider grid, suggestions, sliders, estimate, presets, mobile no-overflow, course-disabled reason). Full approval → progress → completion path verified via backend real-generation test.
